title: Define static Playbook Registry V1 contract
businessObjective: Establish one bounded, versioned playbook registry contract for a future content-schema-repair shadow workflow without enabling execution or production mutation.
technicalObjective: Implement the closed Playbook Registry V1 schema, one finite Tier 0 shadow artifact, and its deterministic Node validator exactly as defined in docs/playbooks/P1-006_PLAYBOOK_REGISTRY_DESIGN.md.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: P1-006 is a repository-only static contract in Tier 0 shadow mode; it grants no runtime authority and cannot execute a tool or alter a file.
The registry contains exactly one disabled content-schema-repair-shadow V1 entry with empty permitted tool and path lists.
The required historical success and rollback rates are each null, meaning not recorded for the disabled V1 shadow entry; no telemetry, calculator, runtime storage, or external data is authorized.
The P1-004 reference supplies static taxonomy and deny defaults only; any future runtime authorization remains a separately governed P1-005 V2 concern.
No production write, deployment, database, network, external service, live credential, guest-data, booking, payment, inventory, or pricing access is authorized.
A separate governance packet must admit the exact Node validator command after the validator exists and before independent machine verification.
acceptanceCriteria: schemas/playbook-registry-v1.schema.json is the closed Draft 2020-12 structural authority for the documented finite V1 registry and accepts no extra properties.
playbooks/playbook-registry-v1.json contains exactly the documented registry identity, P1-004 deny-taxonomy reference, and one disabled Tier 0 shadow content-schema-repair entry.

The single entry has productionWritePermission false, empty permittedTools and permittedPaths, exact fixture-only trigger and evidence requirements, exact deterministic check identifiers, no activation approval, zero retries, and no-mutation rollback.
The single entry requires historicalSuccessRate and historicalRollbackRate, each exactly null/not-recorded; omission or any non-null value is rejected without calculating or retrieving a rate.
node tests/playbooks/validate-playbook-registry-v1.mjs loads only the committed canonical schema and artifact, validates the finite contract, and rejects the focused mutations defined by the design.

Malformed JSON, altered authority, unexpected fields or values, activation, production-write permission, tools, paths, retries, or mutation-capable rollback fail deterministically with a nonzero exit.

P1-006 adds no runtime runner, dispatcher, evaluator dependency, service, command execution, telemetry, rate calculator, runtime metric storage, external data, database, network call, credential access, production behavior, or package restructuring.
The exact validator runs explicitly in CI, and independent QA confirms forbidden paths were untouched after separate exact-command verifier admission is merged.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P1-006 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: machine verification evidence after exact-command admission
solEscalationTriggers: Any proposal broadens the finite registry, permits a tool or path, enables a playbook, adds runtime execution, or treats the P1-004 reference as an allow decision.
Any required change crosses declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, or workflow-correctness ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the P1-006 registry artifact, schema, validator, design document, task-state changes, and task evidence; preserve P1-004/P1-005 authorities, historical evidence, canonical architecture, the immutable compatibility snapshot, and all external systems.
